'''Hak Soo Kim''' made the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] final twelve. Kim qualified through Coruscant Rochester from San Francisco, California.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="trando">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/wf00p2.htm History of the World Finals], [[Trandosite]].</ref> Kim published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs and won the [[1997 Corellia Regionals (Columbus)]].

* [[Hak Soo Kim Anti-Revolution]] (DS, July 1996)
